title: SVD-AE: Simple Autoencoders for Collaborative Filtering
summary: The paper addresses the trade-off among accuracy, computation time, and noise robustness in lightweight collaborative filtering. It proposes SVD-AE, a linear autoencoder on a symmetrically normalized interaction matrix whose closed-form solution uses truncated SVD with rank m and no iterative training. Across Gowalla, Yelp2018, ML-1M, and ML-10M, SVD-AE reports the best HR@10, NDCG@10, and PSP@10 while being much faster and more noise-robust than baselines.

match_target.why: HR@10 on ML-1M is the single row given by the user's hint and directly demonstrates SVD-AE's central accuracy claim; it requires only the closed-form truncated-SVD pipeline, not an ablation.

tolerance.why: Rule 2: HR@10 is an accuracy-like percentage metric; ML-1M has 6,040 users in Table 4 (>2,000 evaluation cases); no repeated-run std is reported, so the band is 1.0 absolute percentage point.

requirements.stmt: Compute truncated SVD and keep only the top-m singular vectors and singular values.
requirements.quote: The truncated SVD uses only the first m columns of Q and V and the first m largest singular values.

requirements.stmt: Set rank m from γ and the smaller matrix dimension using m=⌊γ×min(|U|,|I|)⌉.

requirements.stmt: Do not add an iterative training loop; the model is solved once in closed form.
requirements.quote: SVD-AE does not require iterative training processes as its closed-form solution can be calculated at once.

requirements.stmt: Use the same train/validation/test splits as the cited prior work for all datasets.
requirements.quote: we use the same train/validation/test splits as done in [He et al., 2020; Shen et al., 2021; Sachdeva et al., 2022].

requirements.stmt: Treat all observed user-item interactions as positive implicit feedback.
requirements.quote: all user-item interactions are treated as positive, so that all the datasets are implicit feedback.

requirements.stmt: Use 10-core preprocessing for Gowalla/Yelp2018 and the published 5-core ML-1M/ML-10M data.
requirements.quote: Gowalla and Yelp2018 were preprocessed with a 10-core setting [Wang et al., 2019], while ML-1M and ML-10M were published with a 5-core setting.

requirements.stmt: Evaluate with HR@k, NDCG@k, and PSP@k at k=10 for the main table.
requirements.quote: We evaluate the accuracy of all of the methods using HR@k, NDCG@k, and PSP@k

requirements.stmt: Use a randomized truncated-SVD implementation rather than a dense full SVD.
requirements.quote: We use a fast randomized truncated SVD [Halko et al., 2011]

requirements.stmt: Do not add an EASE-style L2 regularizer; the truncated rank m is the low-rank inductive bias.
requirements.quote: Unlike previous methods, SVD-AE does not require an additional regularizer by directly using the truncated SVD as a low-rank inductive bias
